This produces a,b,c equal to claimed expectation matrix Y. For any involution Q let I internal transpositions, C cross transpositions and F fixed points, F+2(I+C)=3r. Residual R=A-Y has pairing <R,Q>=-3ra+(2a+1/3)I+2(a-c)C. For even r a=c and maximum I=r; for odd r F>=1 bounds C<=(3r-1)/2-I and maximum at I=r,F=1. Candidate mixture attains that supporting hyperplane, globally proving unique Euclidean projection.
